name: cosmic-tech
description: COSMIC technical breakdown for one function: data-movement subprocesses (E/X/R/W) per functional process with exact CFP counts checked against the budget, refined from a green cosmic-func artifact.

cfpMinRatio.description: Total CFPs below desiredCfps × this ratio is an error; between this and 1.0 is a warning (rule tech/cfp-total-vs-budget)

cfpMaxRatio.description: Total CFPs above desiredCfps × this ratio is an error; between 1.2 and this is a warning (rule tech/cfp-total-vs-budget)
